scope: Public R4/R5 JSON resource validations with per-run profile modes and offline terminology. The base-mode run repeats resources also measured with declared profiles; counts are validation attempts, not unique resources. Unverifiable terminology boundaries are omitted before both verdict and error comparison; explicit semantic rule identities match findings one-to-one. Explanation/policy-adjusted agreement is not used as parity.

packageStore.inventoryScope: Unpacked package JSON definitions and per-package generated indexes; immutable root-level index files recorded separately. Compressed download archives are not loaded with downloads disabled.

limitations: Records and HAPI share the frozen primary package definitions; Records terminology also reads the separately inventoried bundled fallback stores. Canonical selection can differ between engines.
The comparable subset excludes unavailable reference profiles and any Records issue explicitly marked validationComplete=false. Incompleteness counts on the two sides can overlap.
Full-denominator verdict agreement describes matching error/no-error diagnostics, including incomplete validations; it is not a conformance certificate.
Reference execution failures have no inferred verdict and remain in the full attempted denominator.
Both validators rejecting a resource does not imply they found the same defects.
Disagreement classifications are triage hypotheses, not proof that the reference or Records is defective.
This offline measurement does not establish online terminology parity or certify other package versions.
